scope: Product and article templates; additive coverage under ACCEPTANCE-CHECKLIST.md

references.observed: Read through the web tool during this work: hero with image, type, title, description and quote/call actions; four metrics; introductory paragraph; six-image gallery; features and image; two technical specification groups; four installation steps; compressor section; manufacturer advantages; FAQ; finance; brand section; downloadable checklist; contact CTA and related links.
references.implementation: One shared product template with these section types and five model records. Images and body copy use the authorized placeholders. Product links use full-document anchors. Quote actions retain the existing shared quote dialog, consistent with the original product page's explicit quote button. Gallery is static; no unsupported image modal was introduced.

references.observed: Read through the web tool: large opening image, Back to Resources link, title, date/read time/byline, multiple long-form sections, article FAQ, related article links.
references.implementation: Shared article template with opening image, byline, long-form sections, FAQ and related links. Article body is placeholder prose as authorized.

references.observed: Read through the web tool: breadcrumb/category, title, deck and editorial metadata, leading image, highlighted takeaways, in-page table of contents and long-form content.
references.implementation: Optional editorial presentation within the shared article template adds the deck, takeaways and functioning section-anchor TOC.

references.observed: All 15 original article URLs are present, including the seven checklist articles and eight legacy athlete/practice stories.
references.implementation: Preserved all 15 accepted blog cards and mapped each card and resource story to its own original URL; none use summary dialogs or a shared unrelated route.

limits: The insurance article URL returned a cache miss on its one web retrieval. It uses the authorized shared article template; independent original structure for that article was not verified.
Only representative original product and article structures were reviewed; individual image fidelity and complete model specifications are not asserted.
Product image repetitions and placeholder paragraphs are intentional under the user's authorization. No backend was added for the existing preview quote dialog.
Visual and browser-flow verification results are recorded separately by the main integration checks.
